mapper.sql: id, org_id, activity_id, title, description, assignee_member_id, priority, due_at, status, completed_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (org_id, activity_id, title, description, assignee_member_id, priority, due_at, status, created_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{activityId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{assigneeMemberId}, #{priority}, #{dueAt}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'), due_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, assignee_member_id = #{assigneeMemberId}, priority = #{priority}, due_at = #{dueAt} WHERE id = #{id}
